tasks.brief:
Implementation constraints: Edit src/static/threads.js. Add a new module-level function `highlightSearchHits()`. Call it at the end of `switchThread()` (after `renderThreadMessages` and `restoreThreadModelState`). In the existing 'input' listener on the thread-search element, after the existing `renderSidebar()` call, re-render the open thread's messages exactly the way `deleteMessage()` does it (clear chat-container innerHTML, toggle show-thinking class, call `renderThreadMessages` on the active thread if one exists), then call `highlightSearchHits()`. No other edits to this file. No async, no external libraries.

Behavioral specification: 1) New function `highlightSearchHits()`: operates on element with id "chat-container". If `threadSearchQuery` is empty, return immediately. Otherwise, walk ALL TEXT NODES under the container using `document.createTreeWalker` with `NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT`. For each text node whose text contains `threadSearchQuery` case-insensitively, replace that text node with a sequence of nodes where every matched substring is wrapped in `<mark class="search-hit" data-testid="search-hit">` (preserve original casing; non-matching segments stay plain text nodes). Skip text nodes inside existing `<mark>` elements. After wrapping, if at least one mark was created, call `scrollIntoView` on the first one (block 'center'). 2) Call `highlightSearchHits()` at the end of `switchThread()`. 3) In the existing 'input' listener on the thread-search element, after `renderSidebar()`, re-render the open thread's messages (clear chat-container innerHTML, toggle show-thinking class, call `renderThreadMessages` on the active thread if one exists), then call `highlightSearchHits()`.

Acceptance condition: Typing in the search input highlights matching text in the open thread's messages; empty input removes highlights.
